description: The row limit is checked only after appending.
trigger: Pass `--rows 0` or a negative row count with at least one available window, assuming progress setup succeeds.
expected_behavior: Reject an invalid count, or honor a zero-row request without scoring an unintended row.
actual_behavior: The local helper appends one window and only then stops because `len(seqs) >= rows`. Its direct caller `main` loops over the returned shape, not the request, so it can score that row. The separate parent comparison helper checks a truthy `max_rows`, giving zero a different meaning there: no cap.

verification.description: The copied loop returned start zero with a requested count of zero and an available 2048-token window.
verification.limits: The check did not run Rich or the model; it isolates the append-and-stop logic.

introductions.rationale: The new Transformers entry point copies the append-before-cap helper and scores its returned rows. This attribution is to that CLI path. The same loop pattern predates it in the native evaluator.
